home.title: Welcome to Klonk
home.description: Learn to code with brick figures – in Klonk-Script, blocks, JavaScript and TypeScript.

learn.title: Learning modules
learn.intro: Klonk-Script basics: step by step from the first command to variables. Each module explains a new topic and has tasks that Klonk checks automatically – with blocks or Klonk-Script. A started module is saved as a project in your Klonk Cloud.
learn.storageHint: Your programs and progress are stored in your Klonk Cloud – you can continue on any device.
learn.notFound: This module or task does not exist.
learn.severalWorlds: Your program is checked in {n} worlds – you can find them via the tabs above the world.

constructs.procedure: a procedure of your own (procedure … end)

check.solved: Well done! Your program solves the task in all worlds.
check.position: In world {world} Klonk ends up on cell {x}{'|'}{y} – the goal is cell {expectedX}{'|'}{expectedY}.
check.direction: In world {world} Klonk ends up facing {direction}, but should face {expected}.
check.cell: In world {world} cell {x}{'|'}{y} looks different at the end than required. Compare with “Show goal”.
check.output: In world {world} the output does not match: expected {expected}, printed {actual}.
check.character_missing: In world {world} Klonk no longer exists at the end.
check.timeout: In world {world} the program does not end – maybe an endless loop?
